960:def _same_json(left, right):
961:    # Compare JSON values, never Python's cross-type numeric equality.
962:    # Object key order is not semantic; array order and each JSON type are.
963:    if type(left) is not type(right):
964:        return False
965:    if type(left) is dict:
966:        return (all(type(key) is str for key in left) and
967:                all(type(key) is str for key in right) and
968:                set(left) == set(right) and
969:                all(_same_json(left[key], right[key]) for key in left))
970:    if type(left) is list:
971:        return len(left) == len(right) and all(_same_json(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right))
972:    if type(left) is float:
973:        import math
974:        return math.isfinite(left) and math.isfinite(right) and left == right
975:    if type(left) in (str, int, bool, type(None)):
976:        return left == right
977:    return False
